rules.statement: A quia timet action should not be entertained merely because the rights of the plaintiff have been disputed by the defendant. To succeed in such action, the plaintiff must establish acts or conduct committed or threatened on the part of the defendant which can be construed as an effective infringement of the alleged interests of the plaintiff.
